corrected_previous_explanation: MEDGULL 2022 falls 13 -> 11 after correcting the other-ID Counter key, 11 -> 11 after same-date exclusion, and 11 -> 9 after discarding short donor days. The earlier attribution of 13 -> 9 to calendar-date exclusion was incorrect.
interpretation: Admission failures are not ecological negative results. Corrected other-individual support and consistent donor/evaluation roles must be established before another confirmatory endpoint.
limits: The diagnostic reads no altitude values, so it is not a new test of vertical individuality.
DELTATRACK's original 6/9 structural result is reproduced; its code did not contain the Counter-key defect.
Short-donor-day exclusion is a distinct modelling choice, not automatically a programming bug.
The original MEDGULL primary n=9 endpoint and score remain closed, not rescued.
Retaining short donor days is only a candidate post-outcome sensitivity, not an independent replication or prespecified primary success.
